title: The KYC Update
intro: A text says your bank account will be blocked today unless you complete your KYC in an app.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Your KYC has expired. Install the Orrin KYC app…

screen.context: You did your KYC at the branch last year.

msg: Install the KYC app and update:

kyc.label: A sudden KYC deadline
kyc.why: KYC-update texts and links are a well-known trick.

block.label: Block-today threat
block.lens: Account blocked today unless you act.
block.why: Banks do not block accounts over a missed text.

link.label: An app file and a look-alike site
link.lens: The link is not the bank's address and ends in ".apk".
link.why: Never install a bank app from a link. Use the official app store.

otp.label: Asks for card details and OTP
otp.lens: It wants your card details and the OTP.
otp.why: No bank asks for your OTP or card details.

sender.label: A bank-like name
sender.why: Sender names are easy to copy.

actions.label: Install the KYC app and update
Open the real Orrin app, or visit the branch

trap.title: Install unknown app?
trap.ask: This app wants to read your messages and show over other apps. Install?

block_report.line: Reported and deleted. Your bank's fraud team had the fake site blocked.

verify.line: The real app showed your KYC as complete. The text was fake. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The fake app read your messages and OTPs and emptied your account.

what_if.go_ahead: Opening the real app, or asking at the branch, would have shown your KYC was fine.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: Banks do not update KYC through an app from a text. Use the official app or visit the branch.

quick_check.q: A text says your KYC has expired and you must install an app from a link or your account is blocked. What do you do?

options.text: Reply to say you already did it
Do not install it. Check in the real app or at the branch, and report the text

quick_check.explain: KYC updates happen in the official app or at a branch, never through a text link.

hints.nudge: Where does a bank really update your KYC?

rows.v: A common trick: use the official site or branch

rows.k: Does a bank ask for your OTP?
